# mobius-gateway 0.16.48

Includes framework 0.16.48 with transient transport retries, clearer patch rejection diagnostics, and shared repetition limits for observable hosted tools. Refreshes the managed Node, Playwright and cloudflared pins and built-in model defaults.

Protocol 97, config 29, Bot catalog/SQLite 10/6 and checkpoint/SQLite 21/14 are unchanged. No record conversion is required from 0.16.47. Existing saved image 2.5 routes using built-in catalogs must be reselected before startup; Codex image 2.6 acceptance has not been live-verified.
